summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives at Qatar with a commanding 98-point lead over Max Verstappen, needing only to manage the gap over the final two races to secure Mercedes' first drivers' championship of the season. With tyre degradation severe enough to limit drivers to 27 laps per set, strategic pit-stop timing and tyre compound selection will determine whether challengers Lewis Hamilton and George Russell can mount pressure on their teammate's advantage. A victory or strong points finish for Antonelli would essentially seal the title before the season finale in Abu Dhabi, cementing Mercedes' dominance in both championships.
